reply:
localStorage is shared across tabs of the same origin; sessionStorage is per-tab. Your original finding stands: storing an auth flag in localStorage will sync that login state across all tabs on your origin. That's the mechanism for the reported behavior.

The fix: either move the flag to sessionStorage (if you want tab isolation), or if you need cross-tab sync for auth, move to cookies and validate them server-side on each request instead of trusting the client flag.
